method: GET {base}/spec/v1/swagger-starter.js -> parse urls[] -> GET each {name,url} YAML -> yaml.safe_load -> paths
note: Paths here are BARE (service-relative, no gateway prefix) as served by each microservice OpenAPI file -- there is no servers: block to mechanically derive the public /api/... path. Cross-reference against spec/cxone_openapi.json (which HAS full /api/ prefixes, sourced from Stoplight + live corrections) or empirically confirm the prefix before calling. This snapshot is best used to (a) discover that a capability/field exists at all before assuming it does not, and (b) spot-check enum/schema drift for an endpoint you already know the prefix for -- as done for the Analytics API in spec/cxone_openapi.json.
